solutions.title: Creating value through intelligent solutions
solutions.subtitle: With deep domain expertise across key industries, DXS delivers practical software solutions for complex operational challenges.
solutions.spaTitle: Centralized appointment and patient record management
solutions.spaDesc: Digitize scheduling, service records, and customer care across clinics and healthcare facilities.

domains.title: Streamline operations, optimize costs, and increase output across the production line
domains.pain: Fragmented shop-floor data makes it difficult to track order progress, control bill of materials (BOM), and calculate accurate production costs.
domains.solution: Partner with manufacturers to streamline operations, optimize costs, and increase output across the entire production line through centralized MES and WMS platforms.
domains.aiFeature: Production line data analytics to forecast material requirements and reduce wastage.

domains.title: Unify omnichannel sales data, inventory, and customer experience
domains.pain: Selling across multiple channels (POS stores, marketplaces, websites) leads to fragmented inventory data and delayed reconciliation.
domains.solution: Build a centralized retail platform that synchronizes inventory and orders in real time across branches, logistics providers, and accounting.
domains.aiFeature: Seasonal demand forecasting and automated inventory replenishment planning.

domains.title: Digitize appointment scheduling, service records, and customer care
domains.pain: Manual scheduling and record-keeping cause booking conflicts, fragmented service histories, and slow staff performance tracking.
domains.solution: Deliver a centralized scheduling and customer management system with automated appointment reminders and post-service follow-ups.
domains.aiFeature: Automated consultation, appointment confirmation, and retention analytics.

domains.title: Optimize warehouse operations, delivery dispatch, and supply chain visibility
domains.pain: Manual wholesale order processing, credit limit checks, and batch/expiry inventory tracking consume excessive time and labor.
domains.solution: Deploy a B2B ordering portal, FEFO warehouse management system, and real-time delivery route dispatch platform.
domains.aiFeature: Automated document extraction for delivery slips and route optimization.

domains.title: Standardize project management, resource allocation, and financial control
domains.pain: Scattered project documentation and task tracking make it difficult to monitor resource utilization and contract profitability.
domains.solution: Build a unified enterprise portal covering contract management, task workflows, expense approvals, and real-time project P&L reporting.
domains.aiFeature: Automated progress reporting and early risk alerts for delivery milestones.

domains.title: Modernize admissions, academic management, and student engagement
domains.pain: Disconnected admissions counseling, class scheduling, attendance tracking, and tuition management slow down operations.
domains.solution: Implement a comprehensive education management platform connecting admissions CRM, academic scheduling, and student portals.
domains.aiFeature: Learning progress analytics and personalized course pathway recommendations.
